title: Healthy relationships
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Use story characters. Strategies to overcome barriers: honest talk, setting boundaries, forgiving, choosing friends wisely.

skills.key_step: The child names ways of sustaining healthy relationships, barriers to them and strategies to overcome the barriers.

floor.question: A friend pushes you to do wrong. What do you do?
floor.answer: say no clearly and walk away

steps: Pick a strategy for the barrier.

board.do: Wait for an answer such as honest talk or celebrating others.
Write two more barriers and strategies.

misconceptions.repair: Ask how the person being gossiped about feels and what happens to trust.

misconceptions.ask: Which is a barrier to a healthy relationship?

misconceptions.repair: Tell a story where forgiveness saved a friendship.

misconceptions.ask: Can saying no to a friend's harmful request keep the friendship healthy?
misconceptions.repair: Role-play a kind but firm no.

checks.question: Give two ways of sustaining a healthy relationship.
checks.answer: any two of: respect, honest talk, trust, forgiveness, listening

checks.question: Give one barrier to a healthy relationship.
checks.answer: any of: jealousy, mistrust, gossip, peer pressure
